snippet.title: FRAGA - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
You’ve gotten lost in the forest… will you manage to escape?

Fraga is a turn-based tactical roguelite in which you take on the role of a pilgrim lost in a mysterious forest, an adventure inspired by Galician mythology, traditions, biodiversity, and sense of humor.

Wishlist our game on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4541350/Fraga/ 

Follow us on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/fraga.game/

Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/AXtkBE6Qza
